mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, practitioner_id, visit_time, content, next_visit_time FROM t_follow_up WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_follow_up (user_id, practitioner_id, visit_time, content, next_visit_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{practitionerId}, #{visitTime}, #{content}, #{nextVisitTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_follow_up SET user_id=#{userId}, practitioner_id=#{practitionerId}, visit_time=#{visitTime}, content=#{content}, next_visit_time=#{nextVisitTime} WHERE id=#{id}
